//: Which mods each build ships. Entries are folder names under mods/ (data-only mods) or built .nrm files (code mods). A mod not listed here ships nowhere: example mods and code-mod source folders stay out. Desktop: tools/mods/stage_mods.cmake stages next to the exe (and into dist/ for Release). Android: android/app/build.gradle bundleMods packs into the APK.
